name: RfcUntouchedManualDraftHardDelete
purpose: Permit hard deletion only for the exceptionally narrow untouched local RFC draft allowed by authority; otherwise preserve identity/history through lifecycle/archive/correction.

profiles.canonical_encoding: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical UTF-8; SHA-256 lowercase hex

local_guard_registry.blocked_when: there is not exactly one ticket.rfc.identity_created_or_adopted audit for this rfc_id with valid RfcIdentityAuditV1 creation_context manual|provisional; accepted_source_adoption, missing, duplicate or malformed creation evidence blocks
rfc_current_source_projection contains any row for rfc_id
rfc_hierarchy_edges contains any row whose parent_rfc_id or child_rfc_id equals rfc_id, regardless of current edge_state
sr_rfc_links contains any row for rfc_id, regardless of current link_state
rfc_device_reference_links contains any row for rfc_id, regardless of current link_state
rfc_working_notes contains any current row for rfc_id OR an LLD-03 WorkingNoteAuditV1 audit records owner_type=rfc and owner_id=rfc_id, including removed/edited history

any audit event directly targeting target_type=rfc,target_id=rfc_id exists other than the single permitted ticket.rfc.identity_created_or_adopted creation event; the current hard-delete command is evaluated before its receipt/audit exists

provider_reader_contract: Every hard-delete dependency/provenance classifier above is read-only and accepts the canonical reader context: a stable ReadSnapshot for PreviewRfcHardDelete or the current writer UnitOfWork connection/read context for HardDeleteRfc. The same provider predicate/classification authority is used in both paths; no preview-only or commit-only policy is permitted.

provider_classification_token.ownership: LLD-03 derives and validates this token from the provider classification; providers do not expose internal dependency rows or define a second token format
provider_classification_token.sufficiency_rule: the owner command re-runs every provider classifier under the authoritative writer UnitOfWork read context. A change that affects delete eligibility must change CLEAR/BLOCKED/INDETERMINATE and therefore changes this token; provider-internal changes that preserve CLEAR do not change deletion eligibility.

eligibility_fingerprint.object_key_order_semantics: canonical JSON key ordering is supplied by StrictVersionedJson; arrays use the fixed registry ordinal order below

object.rfc_no: exact NC plus fourteen ASCII digits
object.local_guards: array of every local_guard_registry entry exactly once in ordinal order as {code,status:CLEAR|BLOCKED}
object.providers: array of every provider_registry entry exactly once in ordinal order as {provider_id,status:CLEAR|BLOCKED|INDETERMINATE,freshness_token:SOMA_RFC_HARD_DELETE_PROVIDER_CLASSIFICATION_V1 sha256}

eligibility_fingerprint.hash: SHA-256 lowercase hex of canonical UTF-8 object

blocker_projection.local: for each BLOCKED local guard emit RfcHardDeleteBlockerV1 with code=guard code and source=local, in local guard ordinal order
blocker_projection.providers: for each provider after all local blockers, emit blocked_code when status=BLOCKED or indeterminate_code when status=INDETERMINATE; source equals provider_id; provider order is source_evidence,tasks_objectives,inventory,communications
blocker_projection.bounded: at most 15 blockers: eleven local guards plus one result for each of four providers

eligibility.true_when: all eleven local guards are CLEAR and all four provider classifications are CLEAR

preview.mode: one stable LLD-01 ReadSnapshot; all local guards and all four provider classifiers execute read-only against that same snapshot authority
preview.rule: preview is advisory; it returns the exact current eligibility_fingerprint even when blocked. UI may request deliberate-action proof only from an eligible preview and binds that proof to rfc_id, rfc_revision and eligibility_fingerprint.

command_envelope_binding.semantic_payload: rfc_id/path identity, base_revision and eligibility_fingerprint are semantic authority; deliberate_action_proof bearer/challenge/token material is excluded from COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 request hashing
command_envelope_binding.rule: proof exclusion is required so exact same-command replay can resolve before proof validation even after the original one-time proof was consumed; changing rfc_id, base_revision or eligibility_fingerprint remains an idempotency conflict

command_order: CommandBoundary exact replay check occurs before prepare, owner-state reads or proof/provider work; replay returns the stored HardDeleteRfcResultV1 without reading the deleted RFC
validate request shape/proof bearer representation without consuming it
BEGIN IMMEDIATE one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork and load exact RFC identity, rfc_no and revision; missing target returns NOT_FOUND
if current RFC revision differs from base_revision return RFC_HARD_DELETE_PREVIEW_STALE
rerun all local guards and all four provider classifiers against the current UnitOfWork read context and recompute provider tokens, blockers and eligibility_fingerprint
if any blocker or INDETERMINATE exists return RFC_HARD_DELETE_BLOCKED before proof consumption and without receipt/audit/delete
if recomputed eligibility_fingerprint differs from request eligibility_fingerprint return RFC_HARD_DELETE_PREVIEW_STALE before proof consumption

call LLD-12 DeliberateActionProofProvider.validate_and_consume with expected_action=tickets.rfc.hard_delete, target={target_type:rfc,target_id:rfc_id}, base_revision and preview_fingerprint=eligibility_fingerprint; any action/target/revision/preview/session/expiry/single-use mismatch returns RFC_HARD_DELETE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with no domain mutation
allocate hard-delete audit_event_id; its value is also the immutable hard_delete_evidence result id

insert exactly one command_receipt, then append ticket.rfc.hard_deleted audit while rfc_id/rfc_no are still available; payload contains only RFC identity, reviewed revision, eligibility_fingerprint and result=deleted. It contains no challenge id, proof token, session/run binding or other LLD-12 secret/internal identifier; audit has exactly one result ref {type:hard_delete_evidence,id:audit_event_id}

DELETE only the exact rfcs row; no dependent delete/unlink/cascade is attempted. Any unexpected FK/constraint aborts and rolls back receipt/audit/delete; consumed deliberate proof remains non-reusable per LLD-12
store exact HardDeleteRfcResultV1 in command_receipt_results in the same UnitOfWork and commit

result_replay.rule: fixed-size committed result is replayed exactly and is never reconstructed from current state after the RFC row is gone

audit_resolution: LLD-01 audit_events.target_id and audit_event_results.result_id are evidence text, not RFC foreign keys, so the creation audit and hard-delete evidence survive deletion. No audit exception weakens eligibility.
rules: no dependent deletion, unlink or cascade is used to manufacture eligibility
a manual/provisional RFC with any independently protected WFM/Task/Objective/Communication/Inventory history is not hard-deletable
ordinary imported/adopted/history-bearing RFCs use archive/terminal/correction flows instead
hard deletion never applies merely because RFC is archived, terminal, old, omitted from workbook, or currently has no active WFM
repositories expose no generic RFC delete method outside this service
provider classification tokens are eligibility-classification freshness evidence, not provider database snapshots; writer-time provider reclassification remains authoritative
proof is single-use friction evidence only; it is never persisted by LLD-03 and never substitutes for current eligibility revalidation
